from pathlib import Path
import json

def build(blueprint, output_path):
    params = json.loads(blueprint["parameters_json"])
    title = params["title"]
    description = params["description"]
    leading = "\n\n" if blueprint["blueprint_id"] == "leading-blank-lines" else ""
    Path(output_path).write_text(leading + title + "\n" + description + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
reference_impl:
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tempfile
import unicodedata

from cookiecutter.main import cookiecutter


class UserInputError(ValueError):
    pass


def _read_description(input_path: Path) -> tuple[str, str]:
    try:
        text = input_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (FileNotFoundError, IsADirectoryError, PermissionError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
        raise UserInputError("项目说明文件必须是可读取的 UTF-8 文本文件") from exc
    lines = text.splitlines()
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        title = line.strip()
        if title:
            return title, "\n".join(lines[index + 1:])
    raise UserInputError("项目说明文件必须包含至少一个非空标题行")


def _distribution_name(title: str) -> str:
    ascii_title = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", ascii_title.lower()).strip("-")
    return slug or "project"


def _write_template(template_dir: Path) -> None:
    (template_dir / "cookiecutter.json").write_text(
        '{"project_name":"Project","project_description":"","distribution_name":"project"}\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    project = template_dir / "project"
    (project / "src" / "starter_project").mkdir(parents=True)
    (project / "tests").mkdir()
    (project / "README.md").write_text(
        "# {{ cookiecutter.project_name }}\n\n"
        "<!-- project-description-start -->\n"
        "{{ cookiecutter.project_description }}\n"
        "<!-- project-description-end -->\n\n"
        "## 开始\n\n"
        "在此目录运行：\n\n"
        "```sh\n"
        "./run_tests.py\n"
        "```\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (project / "pyproject.toml").write_text(
        "[project]\n"
        "name = {{ cookiecutter.distribution_name | tojson }}\n"
        "version = \"0.1.0\"\n"
        "description = {{ cookiecutter.project_description | tojson }}\n"
        "requires-python = \">=3.9\"\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (project / ".gitignore").write_text("__pycache__/\n*.py[cod]\n.venv/\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (project / "src" / "starter_project" / "__init__.py").write_text(
        "\"\"\"Starter package for the generated project.\"\"\"\n\n"
        "PROJECT_NAME = {{ cookiecutter.project_name | tojson }}\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (project / "tests" / "test_smoke.py").write_text(
        "import sys\n"
        "from pathlib import Path\n"
        "import unittest\n\n"
        "sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'src'))\n"
        "from starter_project import PROJECT_NAME\n\n"
        "class StarterProjectTests(unittest.TestCase):\n"
        "    def test_project_name_is_present(self):\n"
        "        self.assertTrue(PROJECT_NAME.strip())\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    runner = project / "run_tests.py"
    runner.write_text(
        "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n"
        "import sys\n"
        "from pathlib import Path\n"
        "import unittest\n\n"
        "def main():\n"
        "    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent\n"
        "    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'src'))\n"
        "    suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover(str(root / 'tests'))\n"
        "    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)\n"
        "    return 0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1\n\n"
        "if __name__ == '__main__':\n"
        "    raise SystemExit(main())\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    runner.chmod(0o755)


def build_workspace(input_path: Path, output_dir: Path) -> None:
    title, description = _read_description(input_path)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_dir:
        template_dir = Path(temporary_dir) / "embedded-template"
        template_dir.mkdir()
        _write_template(template_dir)
        cookiecutter(
            str(template_dir),
            no_input=True,
            extra_context={
                "project_name": title,
                "project_description": description,
                "distribution_name": _distribution_name(title),
            },
            output_dir=str(output_dir),
        )

semantic_commitments.public_text: 项目说明中跳过前导空白行后的首个非空行会去除行首尾空白，作为项目标题写入 README 的一级标题。
semantic_commitments.rationale: 让一份普通说明文件即可明确生成项目的可见名称。

semantic_commitments.public_text: 标题行之后的所有逻辑行按原有顺序连接为项目说明，并写入 README 的说明标记之间；说明允许为空。
semantic_commitments.rationale: 保留用户提供的项目背景，方便开工和交接。

semantic_commitments.public_text: pyproject 的 `[project].name` 由标题经 NFKD 规范化、移除非 ASCII 字符、转小写、将连续非 ASCII 字母数字字符替换为一个连字符、去除首尾连字符得到；若结果为空则使用 `project`。
semantic_commitments.rationale: 为固定模板提供适合作为 Python 项目发行名称的稳定标识。

semantic_commitments.public_text: 生成的 `starter_project` 模块会以 Python 字符串常量 `PROJECT_NAME` 暴露项目标题。
semantic_commitments.rationale: 给后续业务代码和最小测试提供已连通的项目配置入口。

semantic_commitments.public_text: 固定本地模板经 Cookiecutter 渲染后，工作区恰好包含 README、pyproject、Git 忽略规则、一个 `starter_project` 源模块、一个 smoke 测试和一个测试运行脚本。
semantic_commitments.rationale: 交付一套范围小但可立即扩展且结构明确的项目骨架。

semantic_commitments.public_text: 可执行的 `run_tests.py` 将源目录加入导入路径，发现 `tests` 目录中的 unittest 测试，并以测试成功或失败决定进程状态。
semantic_commitments.rationale: 无需网络或额外依赖即可验证交接后的最小项目状态。
